system.description:
Whenever you damage an adversary with a Virus Token with your Primary or Secondary Weapon, you may consume the Virus Token after @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.WQ0F0R6SNEkMITCA]{Propagation}. If you do, choose one:

  • Apply an Intrusion to every adversary damaged by @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.WQ0F0R6SNEkMITCA]{Propagation} (they also gain a Virus Token this way).

  • Apply a different Intrusion to the original target.
